title: MEIKO — Talking Coffee Time〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So they managed to get revenge on that event they mentioned? What was it called, STAY GOLDEN?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, it seems that way.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Good for them. Especially since they spent so much time practicing here too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure you felt a sense of relief as well, Miku. You seemed so anxious as the event approached.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That was because I know that practicing as much as possible doesn't necessarily mean you'll get results when it matters.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'm so proud of them. Kohane in particular since I heard she did something absolutely incredible.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, really?!
I wish I could've heard her sing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of which...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're here early. Are you done with practice already?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup. We're gonna be in another battle event tomorrow as a team, so we took it easy today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, really...?
Do you think you'll win?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We couldn't be in better shape either.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's great, and I wouldn't expect anything less.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Now then, what can I get you guys?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Here you are, Kohane, An.
That should be everything, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I kinda feel bad about us coming in all together and barraging you with orders.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm doing this because I love it, so there's nothing for you to worry about.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But it never ceases to amaze me how lively this place has become...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, I was saving that cookie for later...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I didn't see your name on it!
The early bird gets the worm, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How is it that you two can fight over absolutely nothing?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line:
Because he...!
Because she...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, Weekend Garage?
It would be nice to try their coffee sometime.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then why don't I bring you some of their original blend next time? All I'd have to do is buy some.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You'd do that?! Thank you, I can't wait to try it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's such a strange thing. Rin, Len and everyone else hardly ever used to come here. Now it's like they're here every day.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, come to think of it, I didn't really see Rin around when we first came here...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. That may also have something to do with her constantly fighting with Len...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But she seemed to be wandering and singing all by herself for some time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I never knew that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, she and Len eventually made up. Then they met all of you, started singing together, and found a home here.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I have a feeling that they saw you guys and felt a need to treat each other better as partners.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, really...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You may have to ask them to find out if I'm right, but I believe so.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for being such a good influence.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It just surprised me a little is all.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. It just felt like we've been relying on you, MEIKO, and everybody else here so much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. That's a two-way street.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You've already done quite a lot for all of us here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We have...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You care about your partners and your team. You work diligently as a team to overcome whatever challenges you're faced with...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Miku, Rin, Len, everyone... They all saw how you worked together as a team and are doing their best to keep up with you guys.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And I couldn't be happier to see them practicing so hard.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, with the exception of KAITO. You know how he is...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I'm also here to make my cafe a place where you can all feel like you belong.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
It really is nice being here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think so too.
You're even here to give us great advice about stuff.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And feel free to keep asking.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Plus, you coming to visit helps make this place just that much more vibrant.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Such a vibrant little cafe.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Hehe. I wonder if our little friend will return too now that this place has become so lively.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to when that happens.
